an3.47:0.3:
Alternative translation: “Monks, these three are fabricated characteristics of what is fabricated. Which three? Arising is discernable, passing away is discernable, alteration [literally: otherness] of what stays is discernable. “These are three fabricated characteristics of what is fabricated. “Now these three are unfabricated characteristics of what is unfabricated. Which three? No arising is discernable, no passing away is discernable, no alteration of what stays is discernable. “These are three unfabricated characteristics of what is unfabricated.”

See also: SN 43; Ud 8:3; Iti 43
